mission.title: Researching the Black Arts
mission.description: Steal computer parts so a tech can research the Black Box.

npc.say: I'll meet you back at my lab once you have the computer parts.
Thank you. I'm going to need some time to research the Black Box. Flood will contact you when I've made progress.

phase.briefing: The purpose behind the mysterious Black Box has eluded us thus far, however, steps are in place to remedy that as we have a tech at our disposal who has agreed to do some research on the Black Box that you located. The tech's name is Alvaro Maloney and he is waiting for you at a Hotel where he will give you an Access Card that will let you into a Machine Storehouse.

enter.say: Alvaro Maloney is staying at this hotel. I've sent you his room number. Go there now.

talk.say: {player}, it's you! I was worried that those masked men might show up... but never mind that now. I have the Access Card that you will need to get into the Machine storehouse. Once you have the computer parts we need, meet me back at my lab.
Conversation logged. Now take the Access Card from Alvaro Maloney.

objective.text: Get the Access Card from Alvaro Maloney

phase.briefing: Now make your way to the Machine storehouse and steal the Computer Parts.

enter.say: Inside this Machine Storehouse they have a storage of the Computer Parts that Alvaro Maloney needs to continue his research on the Black Box. Find one!

done.say: What's in the box?! Nothing! Stupid!
Hacking that computer disabled the locks on the case. You should be able to strip the computer parts right out of the computer itself.

objective.text: Take the Computer Parts from the computer

done.say: You've found the computer parts that we need. Perfect!

phase.briefing: I'm sending you the address of Alvaro Maloney's lab. Deliver the computer parts to him.

enter.say: Alvaro Maloney is waiting for you in his lab.

objective.text: Give the Computer Parts to Alvaro Maloney

talk.say: You've made it back. Do you have the computer parts that I need?

done.say: Computer parts successfully delivered to Alvaro Maloney.
Thank you. I'm going to need some time to research the Black Box. Flood will contact you when I've made progress.

mission.finish: Contact me when you are ready for you next assignment.
